jobs.description:
Labs Strategy and Operations Program Specialist (Milpitas, CA)This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

HPE Labs is seeking an energetic and highly adaptable ***early-career professional***to join the Operations and Outreach team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across a variety of projects, learning new disciplines quickly, and helping teams turn ideas into action. As a Strategy and Operations Program Specialist, you will partner with leaders across HPE Labs and the Office of the CTO to coordinate strategic initiatives, support government-funded opportunities, help execute key events and engagements, and drive operational excellence across the organization.

  

No two weeks are alike! You may be helping coordinate a proposal submission for a federal research opportunity, supporting planning for a major industry event, tracking deliverables for an executive initiative, or helping organize a customer or stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires curiosity, organization, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively across a wide range of teams and topics.

**What You'll Do**

**Strategic Programs & Operations**

* Support planning and execution of strategic initiatives sponsored by HPE Labs leadership
* Coordinate cross-functional projects and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Help establish processes that improve visibility, accountability, and organizational effectiveness
* Develop project updates, reports, briefing materials, and leadership communications
* Support staff meetings, leadership reviews, action tracking, and follow-up activities

**Government Proposals & Contracts**

* Support proposal development and submission activities for U.S. Government-funded opportunities
* Coordinate schedules, requirements, reviews, and stakeholder inputs across multiple teams
* Track proposal milestones, deliverables, and compliance activities
* Assist with lifecycle management of funded programs and related reporting requirements

**Events & External Engagement**

* Support HPE Labs participation in conferences, customer events, executive briefings, and innovation showcases
* Coordinate timelines, logistics, stakeholder communications, and event deliverables
* Help manage planning activities associated with demonstrations, presentations, and executive engagements
* Work with internal partners to ensure successful event execution and follow-through

**Executive & Special Projects**

* Conduct research and analysis to support strategic decision-making
* Support special projects led by HPE Labs and OCTO leadership
* Help drive execution of high-priority initiatives requiring coordination across multiple organizations
* Identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and team collaboration

**What We're Looking For**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or a related field
* 3-5 years of professional experience including project coordination or project-based work experience
* Technical skills and experience using Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, Power BI, AI tools and similar business applications
* Strong organizational and project management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
* Comfortable collaborating with diverse stakeholders across technical and business functions
* Strong problem-solving skills with ability to quickly learn new tools, processes, and business domains
* Self-motivated and resourceful, with the ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal & Professional Development**

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Shared Garden)
jobs.description:
**Shared Garden Coordinator**

*“Valley Verde is dedicated to building healthy and resilient communities by providing low-income families educational programs, edible gardens, and micro-entrepreneurship opportunities that create food security and lead to self sufficiency."*

**Location**: San Jose, Morgan Hill, and Gilroy, CA

**Program:** Shared Garden Program

**Job Type:** Full-time, 40 hours per week

**Benefits:** Paid vacation/sick days

**Job Description:**

Valley Verde is an urban agriculture nonprofit based in San Jose uses home gardening as a catalyst for improving the long-term health of underserved Santa Clara County residents. Valley Verde works with each participant for a year or more, providing a comprehensive set of culturally relevant services and resources to enable families to successfully grow their own organic produce gardens and prepare healthy meals with fresh vegetables. We are seeking a coordinator to expand our Shared Garden Program to reach low-income families. Knowledge of the local area and community organizations local to the area would be beneficial for this role.

Essential job functions: Assist with program organization, implementing Shared Garden Program and assist with tracking all program data.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:

* Travel throughout Santa Clara County to facilitate monthly organic gardening workshops for participants of the Shared Garden Program
* Translate curriculum and facilitate workshops in Spanish
* Communicate via email, phone calls, text messages, or in person, on a monthly basis with participants regarding workshops, attendance, and upcoming events
* Collect and enter data monthly for participant attendance, home visits, and check-ins
* Schedule and conduct monthly check-ins, and quarterly garden visits with participants
* Create and upload training videos to online learning platforms, as needed
* In collaboration with the Program Manager, review and update curriculum, lesson plans, and programming as needed
* Troubleshoot garden issues including diseases and pests using organic methods
* Organize and assist with the distribution of garden materials (heavy lifting, 30-40 lb bags)
* Assist with Planting Weeks and any other program events
* Represent Valley Verde and develop partnerships within the community
* Community outreach, recruit and enroll program participants, volunteers and interns through tabling events
* Assist customers with sales of seedlings at the site
* Assist with the Sow & Grow Community Days
* Create Social Media content for the Shared Garden Program
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Manager

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Must have regular/reliable access to a vehicle with appropriate insurance for transportation
* Must be detail oriented and accurately report program attendance and other participant statistics
* Experience working in a multiethnic community environment
* Ability to develop professional relationships with program participants regardless of language barriers, cultural differences, or physical/mental abilities
* Ability to lift 30-40 lbs for bed, soil and compost distribution
* Must be extremely organized and have the ability to prioritize projects to meet deadlines consistently
* Must be able to work independently and collaboratively in a team, show creativity, and ability to initiate and complete projects with limited supervision
* Bi-lingual English/Spanish or English/Vietnamese required
* At least 1 year of teaching or group facilitation preferred
* At least 1 year of experience growing organic vegetables and urban gardening preferred
* Strong verbal and written communication skills required
* Excellent computer skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Suite, Mailchimp, and Canva
* Must be able to sit, stand, walk, lift, bend, and twist to complete garden projects and activities
* Experience operating power tools, building, and assembling irrigation systems is a plus

**Education:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Community Development, or Education strongly preferred.
* Master Gardener’s certification is strongly preferred.
* Other related coursework or experience can be substituted.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist I *PC 1563
jobs.description:
Your Role:

This position supports the implementation of the quality systems in compliance with cGMPs and other company policies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

* Perform review of batch records for final product, cell banks including in-process testing, QC release testing data packages, labeling, packaging, and all supporting documentation.
* Inspect, review, and disposition raw materials, reagents and components.
* Facilitate investigations relating to manufactured products and raw materials.
* Provide QA oversight during GMP manufacturing operations.
* Conduct line clearances, in-process inspections, support final product packaging operations, etc.
* Support the implementation of the Change Control, Deviation Reporting and CAPA programs.
* Review and revise standard operating procedures, study protocols and reports, etc.
* Coordinate release final cell-based therapeutic products for clinical applications.
* Participate in audit of internal departments, external suppliers, and service providers and completion of audit reports as needed.
* Review and approve validation and qualification packages including installation, operation, and performance qualifications (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols and reports as necessary.
* Train and provide QA guidance to internal functional groups on Quality Systems.
* Provide environmental monitoring support as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in life science or equivalent with 6-10 years of direct QA experience related to GMP Manufacturing in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in cell-based therapeutics or biopharmaceuticals preferred. Must have strong knowledge of cGMPs.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Schedule: 8:00am to 5:00pm with irregular hours/weekends/nights.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear. The employee is required to stand; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Must have ability to handle more than one task at a time and must work at a rapid pace while maintaining attention to detail.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in a temperature-controlled facility without exposure to extreme hot or cold temperatures. Generally, this job is performed in a cleanroom setting and routinely uses standard medical and research equipment such as centrifuges, biosafety cabinets, microscopes, incubators, chromatography devices and columns, tangential-flow filtration devices and filters, peristaltic pumps and metering fill pumps, pipettes and computers. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to blood, viruses, bacteria, body fluids and other tissues. Employees entering and leaving the laboratory must wear appropriate clothing and protective equipment such as lab coats, glasses and gloves. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The anticipated base salary range has been established at $120,988 - $142,405/year. The salary of the finalist(s) selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialization, skills, abilities, and training. The above salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. In addition to your salary, the Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, and dental insurance, plus a 401(k) plan. All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements. Certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses or commissions.

Miltenyi Biotec is an EO Employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.

Miltenyi Biotec, Inc. participates in E-Verify.

The Company will provide reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on the Company, in accordance with applicable law.

Are you ready to start revolutionizing biomedical research? When you join Miltenyi Biotec, you join a family that is passionate about making a real impact – one breakthrough at a time. For over 30 years, we have played a pivotal role in the design, development, manufacture, and integration of products for sample preparation, cell separation, cell analysis, imaging, and cell culture needs. These developments have led to cutting-edge cell and gene therapies – transformative methods that mobilize the body’s own cells and genetic blueprint to tackle diseases such as cancer and autoimmune conditions. Today, our more than 18,000 solutions play a vital role in paving the way for the medicine of tomorrow.

jobs.title: Overnight Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of interim housing and services for homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With over two dozen interim supportive housing communities and more on the way, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Overnight Operations Coordinator provides mobile operational leadership, training, coaching, scheduling support, and crisis response across LifeMoves Interim Supportive Housing programs in Santa Clara and San Mateo Counties. Serving as the first line of operational leadership overnight, Coordinators partner with Residential Service Coordinators, Resident Managers, Program Aides, Shift Leads, Program Directors, and the Overnight Program Director to ensure safe, consistent, trauma-informed services across sites.

The Overnight Operations Coordinator reports to the Overnight Program Director and is one of two Coordinators who, together with the director, form a three-person overnight leadership team. This position has no direct reports; site leadership retains overall site responsibility and direct staff supervision. Success in this role is reflected in confident frontline staff, effective crisis response, reliable overnight coverage, consistent operations, and stronger collaboration across sites.

This position works 12:00 AM to 8:30 AM on a weekly schedule staggered with the second Coordinator to provide seven-day coverage. The Overnight Program Director sets the primary county assignment and cross-county coverage based on operational needs.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Scope of Authority***

* Provides overnight functional leadership through site visits, training, coaching, staff meetings, scheduling support, and emergency response. May direct and prioritize tasks during the shift, delegate immediate tasks while working alongside staff, approve overnight scheduling details in Paycom within approved overtime guidelines, coordinate authorized temporary reassignment between nearby sites, and direct crisis response.
* Program Directors retain overall site responsibility. Operations and Service Managers, where assigned, or other designated site supervisors directly supervise Residential Service Coordinators, including overnight staff. Formal supervision, evaluations, discipline, hiring, time-off approval, and time and attendance approval remain with site leadership and authorized agency personnel.
* Documents performance concerns and observations, provides immediate coaching and direction, and refers concerns to the employee's supervisor. Coordinates follow-up with site leadership and escalates significant or unresolved concerns to the Overnight Program Director or designated on-call leader.

***Mobile Operational Leadership & Staffing Support***

* Conduct planned and responsive site visits; serve as an accessible operational resource for overnight staff and assess cross-site operational needs.
* Identify systemic and site-specific concerns and act within delegated authority, or escalate to the Overnight Program Director.
* Coordinate authorized temporary staff reassignment between nearby sites to address shortages, considering staff qualifications and required coverage at both sites.
* Provide temporary on-site leadership and hands-on assistance at short-staffed sites when necessary; communicate prolonged coverage needs to leadership without losing sight of cross-site responsibilities.
* Assist with admissions, client transitions, and other operational priorities during periods of increased demand, following approved procedures.
* Collaborate with site supervisors to review overnight task expectations and protect time for safety rounds, monitoring, and crisis readiness. Report recurring staffing gaps, fatigue concerns, and operational barriers.

***Overnight Scheduling & Coverage Support***

* Support overnight scheduling and coverage planning using agency-approved tools such as Paycom, within authorized system access.
* Review overnight schedules and attendance in Paycom to identify coverage gaps, call-outs, and upcoming shortages across sites.
* Approve overnight scheduling details in Paycom, such as shift swaps, coverage assignments, and schedule adjustments, in consultation with site supervisors and in line with agency policy. Approvals must stay within approved overtime guidelines; changes that would result in overtime require prior approval from site leadership or authorized agency personnel. Ensure required staffing levels and qualifications are met at each site.
* Coordinate shift coverage and authorized temporary reassignments between nearby sites, and communicate schedule changes promptly to site leadership, the Overnight Program Director, and affected staff.
* Help staff use scheduling and timekeeping tools correctly.
* Report recurring scheduling patterns, such as frequent call-outs or chronic understaffing at a site, to support proactive staffing decisions.

***Training, Coaching & Recognition***

* Plan and deliver competency-based training in nonviolent conflict resolution, de-escalation, trauma-informed practice, harm reduction, and overnight procedures. Deliver CPR training when qualified and authorized, or arrange qualified instructors.
* Provide day-to-day coaching to Residential Service Coordinators, Resident Managers, Program Aides, and Shift Leads, reinforcing agency expectations through observation, feedback, and hands-on support. Favor coaching over correction whenever possible.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of new overnight employees through demonstrations, scenarios, observation, and constructive feedback. Use quieter periods for learning only when safety and coverage permit.

jobs.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA**

### **About AI Gateway**

AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.

Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.

You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.

Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.

This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. Expect to manage people, projects, model stock, and operations all at once.

### **About the Role**

* **Build and lead the models team:** Hire, coach, and grow the people who run the catalog today and build its intelligence over time. Give people real ownership, give direct feedback, and grow leads who can run their own areas.
* **Run model launches end-to-end:** Scope integrations, coordinate testing and evals, confirm pricing, metering, capacity, and security, and get docs and announcements ready. Prepare day-zero launches in advance so they can ship in minutes.
* **Keep the catalog true:** Make sure what we publish (capabilities, limits, versions, prices) matches what developers actually get. Catch silent regressions, such as broken tool calling, truncated streams, quantization changes, or usage and pricing mismatches, before customers do.
* **Build model intelligence:** As it comes online, own the evals, capability maps, and per-task rankings behind our auto-routing profiles and model recommendations. Make sure they measure what they claim to, and connect regressions to routing decisions so customers who chose "auto" aren't the ones who discover a problem.
* **Treat the catalog and intelligence as products:** Have a point of view on which models belong in the catalog, which routing profiles to ship, and what market intelligence to publish. Base it on usage, quality, reliability, and cost data. Turn what you learn into roadmap input.
* **Run a lightweight operating cadence:** Keep one source of truth for what's in flight, who owns it, what's blocked, and what ships next. Keep Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned and informed without status meetings.
* **Automate relentlessly:** Turn repeatable steps into scripts, tools, and agent workflows: endpoint validation, eval runs, catalog and pricing reconciliation, regression detection, and provider follow-ups. Manual effort per launch should fall as the catalog grows.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Day-Zero & Quality Launches:** Ensure new models launch on day zero with tested capabilities, accurate pricing, docs, and a clear call on routing eligibility.
* **Catalog Reliability & Health:** Ensure the catalog reflects reality, and proactively identify when a model or provider is underperforming before customers notice.
* **Auto-Routing & Optimization:** Deliver auto-routing that measurably beats a fixed model choice on cost or quality for users.

jobs.title: Office Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Office Operations Manager**

**Family-Owned Business | Established 1961**

**About Us**

Founded in 1961, we are a family-owned business built on long-term relationships with our employees and customers. We operate as a small, interdependent team where everyone contributes, takes ownership, and makes a meaningful impact.

We value accuracy, accountability, initiative, and people who take pride in doing things right the first time.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on Office Operations Manager position for an experienced, detail-oriented professional who understands the day-to-day financial and operational processes that keep a business running.

Our office moves quickly. Priorities shift, requests come from multiple directions, and accuracy and follow-through are essential. We need someone who can step into the role with a strong working knowledge of QuickBooks and practical experience managing the full cycle of purchasing, inventory, customer orders, invoicing, and payments.

**This is not an entry-level accounting or administrative position.** We are looking for someone who has performed these functions in a business setting, understands how the steps connect, and can manage routine transactions independently with minimal training.

You will own core financial and operational processes while serving as a central point of support for the office and the broader team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Receivable & Order Processing**

* Enter and process customer orders accurately.
* Prepare shipping documents and coordinate order fulfillment.
* Generate customer invoices based on completed orders and shipping documentation.
* Post customer payments and reconcile payment records as needed.
* Prepare bank deposits and assist with collections and overdue accounts.
* Maintain accurate customer records and resolve routine billing discrepancies.

**Accounts Payable & Purchasing**

* Create and issue purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Receive and process inventory against purchase orders and supporting documentation.
* Enter vendor invoices into QuickBooks, verifying amounts, quantities, pricing, and supporting records.
* Track invoice due dates and manage payment schedules.
* Prepare and process vendor payments in accordance with company procedures.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, receipts, and vendor invoices.

**Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate inventory records and perform routine inventory checks.
* Track customer-owned inventory separately and maintain reliable records of quantities and movements.
* Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies in coordination with the team.

**QuickBooks & Financial Recordkeeping**

* Use QuickBooks confidently to enter transactions, maintain accurate records, and retrieve financial information.
* Understand how purchasing, inventory, accounts payable, customer orders, accounts receivable, and payments connect.
* Review work for accuracy and completeness and identify inconsistencies before they become larger problems.
* Maintain organized documentation and records to support accurate financial reporting.

**Office Operations & Team Support**

* Answer incoming calls, manage email, and respond professionally to customers and vendors.
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems.
* Conduct internet research and handle administrative projects and requests.
* Manage competing priorities, communicate when deadlines conflict, and follow tasks through to completion.
* Provide practical support to colleagues as business needs change.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Demonstrated, hands-on QuickBooks experience** in a business environment, including entering transactions and managing accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Practical understanding of the complete purchasing cycle, from creating a purchase order through receiving goods, processing the vendor invoice, and arranging payment.
* Practical understanding of the customer order-to-cash cycle, from order entry and shipping documentation through invoicing and posting customer payments.
* Experience maintaining accurate inventory and financial records.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
* A customer-service mindset and the ability to work effectively with customers, vendors, and colleagues.
* Initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and consistent follow-through.

**The Right Fit**

The successful candidate is someone who:

* Can explain how routine accounting and purchasing transactions flow through a business, rather than simply following isolated instructions.
* Has performed the responsibilities described above and can provide concrete examples of their experience.
* Recognizes discrepancies, asks appropriate questions, and takes ownership of resolving routine issues.
* Learns company-specific procedures quickly without needing extensive instruction on basic accounting workflows or software functions.
* Is comfortable in a small office where everyone contributes, priorities can change, and reliability matters.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

Supervises clinic operations, typically spanning multiple providers, clinics and/or practices. Subordinates include staff involved with professional operational functions. Oversight of administrative areas such as practice revenue management, billing systems and procedures, facilities and safety procedures, registration, new patient coordination, scheduling, medical records storage and maintenance, insurance authorizations. May also supervise patient support staff such as medical assistants or LVNs, in coordination with the nursing lead.

The Administrative Supervisor provides frontline operational leadership and direct supervision for practice coordinators and team leads within the UCSF Health Contact Center, Referral and Access Centers, and Call Center. Reporting to the Administrative Manager, this role ensures daily execution of high-quality referral, scheduling, and access services while maintaining real-time operational stability, staff performance, and continuous improvement. The Administrative Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting pod-level performance, resolving escalations, and delivering exceptional patient and provider experience.

* Provide direct daily supervision, coaching, and tactical oversight to practice coordinators and team leads, including real-time monitoring of referral workqueues, inbound call queues, and key performance metrics.
* Review and update work schedules daily to ensure accurate staffing assignments, confirm adherence to projections, and achieve target adherence rates.
* Handle daily communications and escalations by responding to inquiries from staff, team leads, and Home Team (emails, chats, calls, etc.), while checking and actioning personal electronic medical record In-Box messages.
* Manage attendance and timekeeping processes including review and approval of time-off requests, timesheets, attendance tracking, and follow-up on attendance trends.
* Lead and/or attend various meetings (e.g.,1:1 meetings with the Manager and Team Leads,
* Leadership Meetings, Home Team Huddles, Team Huddles)
* Monitor pod performance, respond to service level escalations, and escalate to the Manager as appropriate.
* Submit quality assurance tickets, review issue tracking items, coordinate resolutions with stakeholders, and complete the Leader Standard Work Tracker.
* Conduct monthly 1:1 meetings with practice coordinators and team leads, review screen-recorded calls for quality coaching, and support HR compliance activities.
* Support the professional development of team through updating development plan trackers for direct reports
* Participate in recruitment, onboarding, precepting, competency checks, and performance evaluations (3-month, 6-month, and annual) for practice coordinators and team leads.
* Champion the Medical Center’s House and Telephone Standards while promoting staff engagement, recognition, and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Provide ad-hoc support for special projects, go-live activities, pod-specific huddles, Rings of Defense, and other operational needs as assigned.
  

**Department Overview**

The UCSF Contact Center is an integrated team that supports both patient and provider requests for access to care at UCSF Health. Administrative functions include 1) appointment scheduling, 2) referral intake, review and processing,3) coordinating any other administrative or clinical patient call-based requests to support effective care delivery.

The UCSF Faculty Practice Organization (FPO) is made of up of more than 2,500 clinicians across multiple campuses and satellite clinics. The UCSF Patient Care Access team supports the organization’s goal to be the #1 Health System in Northern California in health care value, patient experience, and employee engagement by ensuring our ambulatory clinics provide timely access to care for our patients. We strive to provide care when, where and how our patients need it. The team works closely with practices to support improvement efforts and with various departments across the organization (e.g., marketing, IT) to set strategic goals and develop innovative patient care.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in related area and / or equivalent combination of experience / training.
* 5+ years relevant progressive experience Req
* Demonstrated supervisory and organizational skills to effectively supervise staff and to manage the complex workflow and multiple priorities involved with clinic / center administration.
* Strong knowledge of clinic / center operations, patient-scheduling systems, medical and insurance terminology, applicable information systems, patient service standards, and regulatory requirement and best practices.
* Strong knowledge of human resources management policies, with the ability to train, monitor, evaluate, and document human resources issues and performance, and to participate in decision-making on human resources matters.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to quickly analyze problems, determine appropriate level of intervention, and develop and apply effective solutions.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaborations with all levels of management and staff, consultants, and outside agencies.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to train and mentor subordinates, to convey complex administrative, clinical, and technical information in a clear and concise manner, and to prepare and present a variety of reports, documentation, analyses, and project proposals
* Strong knowledge of business software and specialized applications and data management systems used in clinic / center operations.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior supervisory experience
* EPIC knowledge

jobs.title: Functional Medicine Health Coach
jobs.description:
**About Root Rx**

Root Rx is a physician-led functional health program built for high-achieving women who are exhausted, dismissed, and done settling for “your labs look normal.” We run advanced functional lab panels, build individualized root-cause protocols, and walk clients through implementation with a dedicated coaching team. Our clients are women dealing with fatigue, hormone imbalance, thyroid dysfunction, gut issues, burnout, and metabolic challenges, and they come to us because conventional medicine hasn’t given them answers.

We’re a fast-growing virtual practice serving women ages 35 to 75. We’re looking for an experienced Functional Medicine Health Coach who shares our mission and wants to help these women finally feel like themselves again.

**The Role**

We are looking for an experienced health coach with a strong background in client-facing coaching and, ideally, experience in functional medicine, hormone health, and nutrition and lifestyle change. You will work alongside our Chief Medical Officer, Head of Coaching, and medical team to guide our growing client base through their protocols, translating clinical recommendations into daily habits, keeping clients accountable, and supporting them through every phase of their program.

This is a part-time W2 position with a path to full-time as our client base grows. You work remotely. You bring the coaching skill and the client connection. We bring the clients, the clinical team, the systems, and the mission.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coach clients 1:1 through every phase of their program, building the trust and accountability that turn a protocol into lasting change (group coaching experience is a plus)
* Interpret functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels with confidence and clinical curiosity
* Connect findings across tests to identify the root-cause drivers behind each client’s symptoms
* Build personalized nutrition, movement, stress, and sleep plans that fit real lives, not textbook ones
* Recommend targeted supplement protocols matched to each client’s root drivers
* Track progress, adjust plans as clients respond, and celebrate the wins along the way
* Partner with our Chief Medical Officer and medical team, escalating clinical concerns and bringing complex cases forward for review

**What We’re Looking For**

**Required:**

* Health coaching certification from a recognized program (NBHWC, FMCA, FDN-P, or equivalent)
* At least 1 years of experience coaching clients 1:1 in functional medicine, hormone health, or gut health
* Demonstrated proficiency interpreting functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels, including connecting findings across tests
* Experience building personalized nutrition, lifestyle, and supplement protocols based on root-cause findings
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you’ll be working with high-achieving clients who ask smart questions
* Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work setup

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Advanced functional medicine training (IFM, FDN, or similar)
* Experience working alongside a physician or medical team in a functional or integrative practice
* Group coaching experience
* Experience supporting women through perimenopause, menopause, thyroid dysfunction, or burnout

**You’re a great fit if you:**

* Are passionate about helping women who’ve been overlooked by conventional medicine
* Thrive in a fast-paced, growing practice and roll with change
* Are highly organized and manage a full client load without dropping details
* Can explain complex findings in plain, compassionate language

**Please read before applying:**

This role is for experienced functional medicine coaches. You must already be proficient in interpreting functional blood work, DUTCH and Hormone Zoomer, and GI-MAP, GI Effects, and Gut Zoomer panels, and in connecting findings across tests to identify root causes.

We do not train on lab interpretation. We’ll train you on the Root Rx process, systems, and client experience, but the clinical interpretation skills need to come with you. Applications that don’t show this experience will not move forward.

**Compensation and Structure**

* 100% remote, open to coaches anywhere in the world
* 30–40 hours/week, with availability for US evenings and weekends
* W2 for US-based coaches; independent contractor outside the US

**How to Apply**

Send the following to jennifer@rootrxhealth.com:

* Your resume or CV, including your coaching certification and any functional medicine training
* **A short introduction video** (2 to 3 minutes): Introduce yourself and tell us how you use root-cause medicine in your coaching today. We’d like to hear about the types of clients you work with, how you approach lab findings, and why this work matters to you. No need for polished production; a phone recording is perfect. We want to see how you communicate, since that’s what our clients will experience.

We review applications on a rolling basis. We look forward to hearing from you!

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Health coaching: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

**Position Title:** REACH Project Manager

**Reports to:** Cancer Programs Director

**Salary Range:** $75,000 - $80,000 Annually DOQ

**Classification:** Full-time, Exempt

**Location:** Remote with occasional travel (approximately 15-20%)

**To Apply:** A résumé and a cover letter detailing your interest in the position and relevant experience are required. Applications submitted without will be automatically rejected.

**About AICAF**

The American Indian Cancer Foundation (AICAF), a national nonprofit, is committed to supporting American Indian and Alaska Native (Ai/AN) cancer patients, communities, tribal leaders, and healthcare providers with the knowledge and resources to improve cancer prevention, early detection, treatment, and survivorship outcomes across Indian Country. By educating and empowering, we can collectively work towards a cancer-free future for our people and future generations.

P**osition Summary**

The REACH Project Manager position involves active involvement in the Racial and Ethnic Approaches to Community Health (REACH) project, a nationwide initiative overseen by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). AICAF was one of fifty organizations to receive this funding aimed at improving health, preventing chronic diseases, and reducing health disparities among racial and ethnic populations with the highest risk, or burden, of chronic disease.

The REACH Project Manager will be responsible for oversight and implementation of the (REACH) project under the supervision of the Cancer Programs Manager. In this role, the AICAF team will lean into your expertise, which will include, but is not limited to: 1) coalition building and facilitation, community engagement, collaboration, and buy-in support with various entities, such as tribal, local, state, and national organizations; 2) the development and dissemination of culturally tailored materials and messaging; 3) knowledge of traditional tobacco practices; 4) the ability to implement activities and strategies to support positive outcomes; and 5) familiarity and capacity to understand and implement policy, systems, and environmental changes related to healthy eating, tobacco, well-being, and promotion of physical activity.

Please Note: while the primary focus of this role involves this ongoing REACH project, you may be asked to contribute to other tasks or projects, temporarily or permanently, as determined by organizational needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and report program activities; manage program budget; and participate in routine CDC meetings, annual performance reporting, and other required program reports to ensure compliance with funding and program requirements.
* Work with the leadership team on the implementation of organizational strategies, policies, and practices.
* Provide guidance and expertise as it relates to program implementation, policies, and coalition building through community collaboration and outreach.
* Provide program grant and contract oversight to effectively support and track employee workloads to successfully deliver program goals and deliverables according to work plans and timelines.
* Supervise and provide ongoing guidance, support, and performance oversight to a Project Coordinator, including workload prioritization, professional development, and alignment with program goals in a collaborative, consultative, and positive manner.
* Communicate program progress and potential issues via regular, timely updates.
* Maintain communications with clinic and community partners, consultants, and funders.
* Identify and pursue new projects and funding opportunities that fit within AICAF's strategic vision.
* Identify, develop, and support responses to relevant cancer issues related to the AICAF mission.
* Plan and disseminate findings to multiple audiences through reports, presentations, etc.
* Work effectively as an AICAF team member through participation across organization initiatives.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

Education and Experience

* Master’s Degree in a health care field, such as public health, nursing, clinical health, or similar.
* At least 3 years of experience with public health programs and working with AI/AN health systems and/or communities.
* At least 3 years of experience in project management, including experience providing supervision to staff and managing workloads to meet program goals and deliverables.
* Experience in grant/contract management (planning, tracking, evaluation, and reporting).
* Solid understanding of evidence-based cancer prevention and control strategies.

General Skills and Abilities

* Must be highly organized and detail-oriented and be able to prioritize and carry out concurrent projects on deadlines, manage complex projects, and maintain self-direction (i.e. carry out all responsibilities of the job requirements with minimal day-to-day supervision).
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with demonstrated abilities in computer technology, report writing, facilitation, team collaboration, and public speaking.
* Sensitivity to cross-cultural differences and ability to work effectively within diverse contexts, demonstrating discretion, tact, knowledge, judgment, and overall ability in working effectively with diverse groups of people.
* Strategic thinker who is also willing to do hands-on work
* Commitment to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and mission-driven workplace culture.
* Ability to navigate sensitive situations with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment.
* Experience with or willingness to learn Microsoft Office tools, including, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and SharePoint.
* Demonstrated high work ethic, integrity, and professional conduct.
* Strong passion for AICAF’s mission, vision, and values.

Other

**Key Responsibilities**

*Client Intake, Matching & Scheduling*

* Monitor and respond promptly to new client inquiries by email and phone.
* Match new clients with the right clinician using our intake and matching system, based on insurance, state licensure, specialty and clinician availability.
* Verify client insurance coverage or payment method and schedule initial sessions.
* Manage and optimize clinician schedules on platforms like SimplePractice, Headway and Zocdoc.
* Earn a $10 commission for every new client you schedule who attends at least 8 sessions.

*Insurance & Credentialing*

* Manage clinician credentialing and re-credentialing with insurance payers, including CAQH profile upkeep and attestations.
* Coordinate with insurance platforms (such as Headway and Lyra) on enrollment, account issues and payer questions.
* Track credentialing status, expiration dates and license renewals across states.

*Billing & Finance*

* Make sure payments are entered and processed the same day.
* Manage communication with our external billing service.
* Track weekly financials, including income and expenses by provider.
* Calculate and send weekly payroll reports and handle clinician compensation.
* Help with bookkeeping and confirm that payments match the sessions billed.

*HR & Multi-State Compliance*

* Onboard new team members through Rippling and maintain accurate employee and contractor records.
* Support multi-state payroll and employer tax registrations as the practice adds clinicians in new states.
* Coordinate records requests, subpoenas and other compliance matters in partnership with leadership.
* Help maintain practice SOPs, contract templates and administrative documentation.

*Hiring & Onboarding*

* Help recruit new clinicians, including interviews and contract processing.
* Onboard new clinicians into practice systems and directories (SimplePractice, Zocdoc, Headway, CAQH, Slack and more).

*Directories, Website & Marketing*

* Maintain clinician profiles on Psychology Today and other directories.
* Keep the WRP website up to date with clinician bios, services and practice announcements.
* Send weekly patient surveys and monthly clinician feedback forms.
* Work with the team on strategies to improve the client experience and grow the practice.

*Operations*

* Support daily administrative work remotely, in collaboration with the General Manager and clinic directors.
* Make sure patient portals and scheduling platforms are used efficiently.
* Be on call during business hours and respond quickly to the team by phone, Slack or email.
* Be flexible with your schedule. Issues sometimes come up on evenings or weekends that need your attention.

*Practice Growth & Strategic Support*

* Work directly with the General Manager and Owner to carry out Wellness Road’s growth initiatives.
* Help plan and carry out operational improvements, hiring goals and client acquisition strategies.
* Help track KPIs, clinician productivity and patient feedback to guide decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proficiency with CRM and practice-management software, or the ability to learn new technology quickly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort managing many moving parts across systems.
* Experience with insurance credentialing, medical billing or healthcare administration is a strong plus.

**Written Questionnaire (Required)**  
To be considered for the Operations Manager position, please complete the short written questionnaire included with your application. We’d love to learn more about you, your experience and what draws you to Wellness Road Psychology.

We’re looking for authenticity and clear communication, not perfection.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
72,000 - 75,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About The African Think Tank**

The African Think Tank (TATT) is seeking a TATT Thrive Program Manager to lead the coordination and delivery of our online TATT Thrive Masterclasses. This is an opportunity for an organized, proactive program professional who can manage details, build relationships with speakers and participants, and help create learning experiences that serve the African Diaspora.

**About TATT Thrive**

TATT Thrive connects people with practical learning and development opportunities across four areas: financial education, career development, entrepreneurship, and parenting and education. Through online masterclasses, we aim to make relevant knowledge accessible, encourage meaningful participation, and create opportunities for continued engagement with the TATT community.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Head of Programs & Impact, the TATT Thrive Program Manager will oversee the planning and coordination of the 2027 Masterclass series, with 11 online sessions scheduled from February through December.

You will help shape the annual program calendar, recruit and coordinate speakers, manage event logistics, collaborate on promotion, and ensure each session has a clear process for participant engagement and follow-up. You will also work with the communications and learning teams to track participation, gather feedback, and strengthen the program over time.

This role is about more than hosting online events. It is about creating a consistent, high-quality learning experience and helping TATT understand how Thrive can introduce new people to the organization and encourage deeper involvement in its community.

**Role Details**

**Position**: TATT Thrive Program Manager  
**Organization**: The African Think Tank (TATT)  
**Type**: Volunteer role  
**Location**: Remote  
**Reports to**: Head of Programs & Impact

**Key Responsibilities**

* Program planning and coordination
* Develop and maintain the annual Masterclass calendar, including topics, dates, formats, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate planning and execution for monthly sessions from speaker preparation through post-event follow-up.
* Establish clear workflows, checklists, and standard operating procedures to support reliable delivery.

**Speaker and facilitator engagement**

* Identify and coordinate potential speakers, drawing on relevant professional networks and TATT’s existing speaker community.
* Manage speaker communications, scheduling, preparation, and required agreements.
* Work with the Head of Learning & Organizational Development to help speakers understand TATT’s facilitation expectations and learning standards.
* Coordinate speaker honoraria approvals with the appropriate finance lead before commitments are finalized.

**Event operations and digital delivery**

* Manage registration, participant communications, reminders, virtual session logistics, and hosting arrangements.
* Coordinate recording, upload sessions to the TATT-U learning library, and ensure recordings are available within seven days after each session.
* Test the full event process in advance and prepare speakers and internal teams for smooth delivery.

**Marketing and audience engagement**

* Work with the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to develop and implement a promotion calendar for upcoming Masterclasses.
* Support outreach to both TATT members and non-members, making sessions accessible to prospective members.
* Coordinate appropriate opportunities to introduce participants to TATT membership and other ways to stay engaged.

**Monitoring, evaluation, and improvement**

* Coordinate participant surveys and follow-up activities, working with the Head of Programs & Impact.
* Track registrations, attendance, first-time contacts, member and non-member participation, and subsequent membership conversion in collaboration with the CMO.
* Summarize feedback and participation data to identify improvements for future sessions.
* Maintain accurate program records and share regular progress updates with relevant team members.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* Work closely with the TATT Thrive Committee, Head of Programs & Impact, CMO, Head of Learning & Organizational Development, and other relevant team members.
* Help ensure the Masterclass series supports TATT’s broader program and community engagement priorities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days, the successful candidate will be expected to**:

* Develop a proposed 2027 Masterclass calendar and end-to-end delivery process for approval.
* Confirm speakers for the first three sessions, with registration and operational workflows in place.
* Establish participation and follow-up tracking in collaboration with the CMO.
* Test the complete Masterclass process, from registration through recording and survey follow-up.
* Secure speakers through July 2027 and prepare the February session for delivery.
* As the series progresses, success will include consistent, well-organized sessions; meaningful participant feedback; timely publication of recordings; and clear reporting on audience engagement and new connections with TATT.
* The program will also aim for a participant survey response rate of at least 50% for the February session.

**Why Join TATT?**

This is an opportunity to help build a learning program with the potential to connect people to practical knowledge, experienced voices, and a wider community of support. You’ll work with a committed team and contribute directly to the development of a program designed to help individuals learn, connect, and thrive.

Pay: $1.00 - $2.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Client Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Meadow**

Meadow is a physician-founded, licensed psilocybin service center in Portland, Oregon. We guide clients through facilitated psilocybin experiences supported by medical screening, preparation, integration, coaching, and medication tapering programs.

Our relationship with clients extends well beyond their time at our center. We also host a growing online community of hundreds of people who have journeyed with us, with live events, integration groups, educational programming, and ongoing opportunities to stay connected.

**The Role**

You are the hand that helps guide clients every step of the way and make sure nobody falls through the cracks.

As Meadow's Client Care Coordinator, you will be the primary operational point of contact for clients throughout their experience with us. You'll answer questions, onboard new clients, coordinate appointments, follow up after sessions, and make sure each person knows what happens next.

You'll also help steward Meadow's online community—welcoming new members, supporting conversations, coordinating community events, and keeping members informed and engaged..

This is not a clinical role. You won't facilitate psilocybin sessions or provide medical advice. You'll know when a question needs to go to a clinician, facilitator, or another member of our team and make sure it gets there quickly.

**What You'll DoClient Care & Coordination**

* Respond promptly to client calls, texts, and emails.
* Onboard new clients and guide them through their first steps with Meadow.
* Schedule and reschedule appointments across our clinical, facilitator, and coaching teams.
* Track clients through their care pathway and proactively follow up on incomplete forms, assessments, appointments, and other requirements.
* Answer routine questions and connect clients with the appropriate team member when additional support is needed.
* Coordinate practical details around preparation, Journey Day, integration, and follow-up.
* Stay connected with past clients and introduce relevant opportunities for continued support, coaching, community programming, or return journeys.
* Gather written and video testimonials from clients who want to share their experiences.
* Maintain accurate, organized client records and ensure important information reaches the appropriate team members.

**Community & Events**

* Help steward Meadow's online community and create a welcoming, active environment for members.
* Welcome new members, answer questions, encourage participation, and help keep community discussions active and constructive.
* Monitor Meadow's client discussion forum and help facilitate meaningful engagement.
* Maintain the community events calendar and coordinate recurring groups, integration circles, educational events, and other programming.
* Communicate with facilitators and event leaders to ensure events are scheduled, promoted, and run smoothly.
* Create and send email broadcasts announcing upcoming events, new programs, community updates, and other opportunities to participate.
* Track community participation and identify opportunities to increase engagement.
* Help develop new ways for Meadow alumni to stay connected with Meadow and with one another.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients receive fast, thoughtful responses and always know what happens next.
* Onboarding, scheduling, forms, and follow-up happen reliably and on time.
* Fewer clients miss appointments or required steps.
* Past clients remain engaged with Meadow and take advantage of relevant ongoing programs.
* Meadow has a steady stream of clients willing to share testimonials and referrals.
* The online community feels welcoming, useful, and active.
* Community events are well organized, clearly communicated, and consistently attended.
* Email broadcasts and community communications go out accurately and on schedule.
* The rest of the Meadow team can trust that when something involving the client journey or community needs to happen, it will happen.

**You're a Fit If You**

* English native speaker
* Are exceptionally organized and can manage many conversations and tasks without dropping anything.
* Are highly tech-savvy and learn new software tools quickly.
* Communicate clearly, warmly, and professionally by phone, text, and email.
* Are comfortable being highly responsive throughout the workday.
* Follow up without being reminded and naturally take ownership of loose ends.
* Enjoy talking with people and helping them navigate unfamiliar or meaningful experiences.
* Have good judgment about what you can handle independently and what needs to be escalated.
* Are comfortable working independently as part of a remote team.
* Can balance genuine warmth with appropriate professional boundaries.
* Enjoy building community and bringing people together.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in healthcare, wellness, hospitality, care coordination, or client success.
* Experience managing an online community, membership program, or events calendar.
* Experience with email marketing or community communication platforms.
* Experience with scheduling, CRM, or healthcare administration systems.
* Interest in psychedelic-assisted wellness, behavioral health, or integrative healthcare.

**Details**

* Full-time
* Remote
* English native speaker
* Pacific Time business hours
* Reports to Mike & Tracy Townsend, Co-Founders
* Works closely with Meadow's clinical team, facilitators, coaches, and leadership

At Meadow, client experience isn't separate from care. The way someone is welcomed, communicated with, prepared, and supported throughout the process matters.

The Client Care Coordinator is the person who helps make sure every client—and every member of our growing community—feels that level of care.

For faster response, apply here: https://meadowmedicine.org/careers/client-care-coordinator

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Patient Strategy & Experience, Customer Experience Lead
jobs.description:
*Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.*

*We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.*

As the Patient Customer Experience (CX) Lead, you are accountable for building and leading the discipline within the argenx Patient Strategy & Experience. You will establish how argenx understands, designs, delivers, and continuously improves the end-to-end experience of patients and caregivers across the enterprise portfolio, therapeutica areas, indications, brands, and stages of the patient journey.

You will create the frameworks, methods, standards, and capabilities that enable argenx to translate patient needs, behaviors, and experiences into meaningful experience-related and business decisions. Through end-to-end journey design, voice-of-patient insights, Design Thinking (DT), Human-Centered Design (HCD), co-creation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping, you will identify the moments that matter most and help Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, Media, and other cross-functional partners design optimal stakeholder experiences.

As a member of the Patient Strategy & Experience leadership team, you will serve as the senior integrator of CX across communities. You will also connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, build & strengthen repeatable models, and help advance a more connected experience across customer groups. This is a new capability for argenx, requiring a leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, build the discipline from the ground up, and influence leaders across the organization to translate patient insight into measurable improvements in the experience argenx delivers.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Customer Experience Strategy & Voice of Patient**

* Define and lead CX strategy and establish the CX discipline across all argenx patient services and communities.
* Develop and maintain an integrated, portfolio-level understanding of patient and caregiver journeys across disease areas, patient populations, and lifecycle stages.
* Establish repeatable approaches for journey mapping, patient personas, touchpoint and channel assessment, and identification of the moments that matter most across the patient experience.
* Define how patient insight and voice-of-patient inputs are gathered, synthesized, prioritized, and translated into strategic priorities and experience decisions.
* Identify experience opportunities, unmet needs, friction points, and gaps across patient journeys and translate them into clear recommendations for relevant communities and teams.
* Maintain a portfolio-level view of evolving patient needs and experiences, helping leadership determine where focused attention and investment can create the greatest impact.
* Ensure CX strategy remains connected to evolving patient, disease, market, scientific, and portfolio dynamics.
Codify CX approaches and learnings into scalable frameworks and practices that can support patient-facing teams and, where relevant, inform broader CX efforts across argenx.  

**Design Thinking, Experience Design & Experimentation**

* Establish HCD/DT, including empathy research, co-creation workshops, and design sprints, as a core approach for developing, prototyping, testing, and improving CX concepts before they are deployed at scale.
* Lead journey design, concept development, co-creation, prototyping, and structured testing approaches that enable argenx to learn directly from patients and caregivers.
* Translate ambiguous or emerging opportunities into clearly defined experience challenges, hypotheses, pilots, and success measures.
* Build an experimentation model that allows new CX concepts to be tested, refined, and de-risked before broader investment and implementation.
* Identify opportunities to create differentiated patient experiences as argenx expands into new disease areas and patient populations.
* Partner with patient-facing teams and external specialists to apply experience design approaches where they can create the greatest value.
* Connect emerging scientific, medical, and portfolio developments to CX planning, so future experience needs are considered early rather than after strategies and programs are established.
Bring a forward-looking perspective on experience innovation, identifying new approaches, technologies, and capabilities that could meaningfully improve how patients engage with argenx and our medicines.  

**Cross-Community & Executive Leadership**

* Serve as the senior CX integrator across Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, and other relevant communities and teams.
* Translate patient journeys, voice-of-patient insights, and experience testing into clear, actionable recommendations for the teams responsible for designing and delivering patient programs and interactions.
* Influence leaders to act on CX opportunities while preserving clear accountability within individual communities and teams for strategy and execution.
* Partner closely with the Vice President, Patient Strategy & Experience, and represent CX directly in enterprise-wide strategic planning, portfolio governance, and executive leadership forums.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**  
**Recycled materials**  
**Location:** Remote — Europe

**About MineHub**
=================

At MineHub, we’re transforming how the world’s largest producers, traders, and consumers manage raw material supply chains. Our solutions combine critical B2B marketplace functionality (handling high-volume transactions for global supply chains) with intuitive B2C design, enabling customers to streamline logistics, reduce costs, and build more resilient, sustainable operations through real-time data integration and predictive analytics.  
Jules extends MineHub’s offering into the recycled materials industry. Scrap and secondary-materials traders, recyclers and brokers use Jules to run their business end to end: buying and selling; managing inventory across yards and stockpiles; container, bulk, and truck logistics; trade documentation; invoicing and payments; and price-risk management.

**The Role**
============

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own customer success for the Jules platform. You'll combine a strong understanding of commodity supply chains with the leadership to build and develop a small, high-performing CSM team. You'll personally own our most strategic accounts while setting the standards, processes, and priorities the rest of the team works to. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be as comfortable running a go-live with a customer's operations team as you are coaching a CSM or making the case to Product for what our customers need next. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll collaborate across CS, Product, Engineering, Sales and leadership.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead, coach and develop the Jules CSM team: set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and help hire as the team scales.
* Own the Jules customer portfolio's health, retention and expansion, and report on it to leadership with clear, commercially grounded metrics.
* Personally manage our most strategic and complex accounts, from implementation through to renewal and expansion.
* Build and continuously improve the team's playbooks: onboarding and go-live, data migration, health monitoring, QBRs, renewals and escalations.
* Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering: synthesise feedback across accounts, frame it in commercial and operational terms, and influence roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Sales on pre-sales scoping, handover and expansion opportunities, ensuring what we sell can be delivered and adopted. (This is not a quota-carrying role.)
* Work with your counterparts across MineHub to share best practice and align ways of working across the group's platforms.

**Experience & Skills**
=======================

* Experience in recycled materials, metals or wider commodities trade is a strong advantage. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you'll be keen to learn how recycled materials are sourced, graded, shipped and documented, and to pick up the industry's terminology quickly.
* Experience leading, mentoring or coaching others, formally or informally: you've raised the performance of the people around you and set a standard others follow.
* Leadership qualities we'll look for at interview: sound judgement under pressure, clear prioritisation, ownership, the ability to give direct and constructive feedback, and the credibility to lead both internally and in front of customers.
* A strong track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and software implementations, with measurable outcomes in adoption, retention or expansion.
* Strong professional English. French is a plus, as we work with a number of French-speaking customers.
* Comfortable with technical topics: data set-up, document workflows, data imports, integrations and reporting. You can get into the detail yourself and guide your team through it. SQL or BI tool experience is a plus.
* Commercially minded. You understand how our customers make money, from margins to logistics costs and price risk, and can tie platform value to their P&L.
* Process-oriented without being bureaucratic. You introduce structure that helps a small team scale, and you know when to keep things simple.
* You're a self-starter who embraces ambiguity and enjoys building something, not just running it.

**Why MineHub?**
================

* Help build the digital backbone of the circular economy, in an industry where secondary raw materials are becoming strategically critical.
* Join a mission-driven team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term thinking in everything from customer relationships to code.
* Be part of a fast-growing company that combines startup energy with partnerships across major industry players worldwide.
* Enjoy the freedom to lead initiatives, own your accounts, and shape how recycled materials businesses experience our platform.

Happy pioneered Frictionless Mental Health™. Instead of waiting for people to ask for help, we reach out first. We partner with health plans, hospital systems, employers, and veterans organizations to bring real emotional support to nurses, veterans, educators, and others who need it. We’re a small, mission-driven, remote-first team, and we’re growing.

Our CEO is a relationship-driven founder who moves fast and has big ideas at all hours. We’re looking for an organized, steady partner who loves bringing structure to that energy and has a real nose for business development. Our leadership writes the content and sets the growth targets. You’ll run everything that turns those ideas into conversations and signed partnerships: our outreach, our social presence, our pipeline, and the follow-through that makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Healthcare experience is a real advantage in this role, but it isn’t required. We’ll teach you the business. Above all, we’re looking for the instincts: someone who follows through, builds systems people actually use, and is confident enough to say, “We agreed to this deadline, and it’s today.”

* Keep our Medicaid provider enrollment applications on track, working with our operations team

* Support the CEO’s calendar and meeting prep as needed
* Spot what’s falling through the cracks and build simple systems to fix it

**What we’re looking for**

* 1–4 years supporting a founder, executive, or fast-moving team, in sales coordination, marketing, operations, or a similar role
* Healthcare experience is highly desirable, especially with health plans, Medicaid, behavioral health, or health systems
* Experience running email campaigns or managing social media for an organization
* A strong, steady personality: warm, and comfortable redirecting a busy executive
* Real joy in organization and follow-through. A clean pipeline and closed loops are satisfying to you.
* Comfort in a sales environment and curiosity about how deals move forward
* Strong writing, and the ability to draft an email in someone else’s voice
* An eye for clean, professional design (Canva or similar)
* Quick to learn new tools (monday.com, Google Workspace, Slack, AI tools)
* A genuine connection to mental health or supportive workplaces. This work should matter to you.
* Availability for overlap with the CEO, generally 12–8 PM Central

**Bonus points**

* Experience with provider enrollment or credentialing
* Relationships with health plans, health systems, or veterans organizations
* Startup experience, or experience with veterans organizations or nonprofits
* You’ve built a tracker, process, or system that other people kept using

For the right person, this role can grow into a larger position in sales operations.

To apply, complete our pre-screening form: https://wkf.ms/3TGlA1w

Pay: $2,500.00 - $3,500.00 per month
